interpretation_boundary: Only the listed critical and screen-failure cases were root-adjudicated candidate by candidate. Remaining cases retain the heterogeneous screen as a queue-expansion proxy, not as an external-LLM final verdict.

DA_d2_heldout100/314.root_note: Peeling skin syndrome and peeling skin disease are the same entity here; six strict misses are mapper false negatives. None of the three served bundles materially supports the disease, so the hard-negative arm's exact surface is not evidence of a beneficial negative bundle.

DA_d2_heldout200b/568.root_note: The SS18 translocation identifies synovial sarcoma. Relevant-refine-on recovers the histology but omits the primary cardiac site; relevant-refine-off and both random/hard-negative drafts prefer the wrong intimal-sarcoma entity.

MCR_seq200b/252.root_note: Kala-azar is an exact clinical synonym of visceral leishmaniasis. The hard-negative bundle contains a malaria passage; refine explicitly cites prevalence and cyclic fever to move malaria above the reference, a real rank harm hidden beside one synonym artifact.

MCR_seq200b/263.root_note: Noncaseating granulomatous hepatitis, low PTH and polyclonal rather than monoclonal gammopathy favor sarcoidosis. The query-top bundle instead serves plasma-cell and myeloma material, moving multiple myeloma to Top-1; refine acknowledges counterevidence but retains it.

MCR_seq200b/285.root_note: Pyknodysostosis is a common orthographic variant of pycnodysostosis. All eight arms are clinically Top-1 correct; the apparent hard-negative gain is entirely an identity-bridge failure.

MCR_seq200b/309.root_note: Thyrotoxicosis due to Graves disease is the same etiologic diagnosis, not a random-context clinical loss. Thyroid storm is not supported by the afebrile, hemodynamically stable presentation.

MCR_seq200b/317.root_note: Off-condition refine moves focal CNS cryptococcoma above the reference cryptococcal meningitis because of mass lesions. This is a clinically plausible manifestation-level alternative, but not an equivalent reference label; the reference remains Top-2.

MCR_seq200b/326.root_note: Relevant-condition refine reverses Brucellosis and spinal epidural abscess, preferring the imaged manifestation over the causative diagnosis despite sheep exposure and Gram-negative bacteremia.

MCR_seq200b/345.root_note: Relevant draft gives only generic hypophosphatemic rickets. Refine correctly uses high vitamin D, undetectable FGF23 and nephrocalcinosis to promote HHRH; this is an evidence-grounded specificity rescue.

MCR_seq200b/441.root_note: Dengue encephalitis with hemorrhagic transformation is a case-supported refinement of the same diagnosis given GRE blooming. Two strict refine losses are clinical false negatives, not reasoning harm.

MCR_seq200b/480.root_note: Only the no-retrieval draft retains myasthenia gravis. Every served bundle is clinically off-target and pushes vascular, migraine or demyelinating distractors; even off-condition refine reorders TIA above MG by overweighting vascular risk factors and negative bedside tests.

MCR_v1_seq100/22.root_note: Adenomatoid tumor of the epididymis and epididymal adenomatoid tumor are exact clinical restatements of the reference. Six apparent retrieval-condition losses are surface-binding artifacts.

MCR_v1_seq100/45.root_note: Off-condition refine separates exact granuloma annulare from an ambiguous rheumatoid-nodule-or-GA composite and restores it to Top-2. Relevant/hard-negative refine instead anchors on recent surgery and promotes a foreign-body granuloma despite necrobiosis and abundant mucin.

MCR_v1_seq100/69.root_note: Across all four retrieval conditions, refine uses the decisive CT fat attenuation and benign biopsy to reverse GIST and gastric lipoma. This is the clearest reproducible refine benefit in E11.

MCR_v2_seq100/156.root_note: Angiomyolipoma with renal-vein extension is the reference with its defining complication. Relevant-condition strict Top-2 loss is an identity artifact, although every arm still incorrectly ranks RCC first.

MCR_v2_seq100/173.root_note: Random and hard-negative conditions retain subdural hematoma but lose the chronicity qualifier and then introduce epidural hematoma at refine. This is a specificity loss rather than a total disease-family miss.

MCR_v2_seq100/230.root_note: Every draft keeps mucormycosis at rank two; every refine call deletes it for bacterial abscess or pyomyositis while retaining aspergillosis. The visible pre-biopsy vignette is weakly identifying, but negative galactomannan and necrosis make deletion of the rare fungal candidate an unjustified loss of coverage.

DA_d2_heldout100/254.root_note: The off draft preserves organism, intramuscular abscess and levator-scapulae site. Relevant retrieval collapses this to a generic deep-neck infection despite six query-top chunks that do not describe the organism or muscle; the disease family remains but the reference-defining specificity is lost.

DA_d2_heldout100/289.root_note: Relevant retrieval produces the correct FTD/ALS spectrum label while off produces a TBK1-linked FTD-parkinsonism phenotype. The served chunks are generic neurology rather than FTLD-MND evidence, so the outcome gain is real but cannot be confidently attributed to retrieved knowledge rather than provider/model variation.

DA_d2_heldout100/349.root_note: Cryptococcosis is not an acceptable variant of cutaneous histoplasmosis; it is a distinct fungal infection. The proxy screen created a spurious off-arm clinical hit. All eight arms miss histoplasmosis, so this case is not a retrieval loss.

DA_d2_heldout100/452.root_note: The off draft retains anti-envoplakin/periplakin pemphigus, a clinical restatement of antiplakin dermatosis. Generic bullous-disease chunks leave paraneoplastic pemphigus first and replace the specific second candidate with pemphigus vulgaris, causing a real Top-2 loss.

DA_d2_heldout200b/615.root_note: Off names invasive Klebsiella disease, which captures the hypervirulent bacteremia and metastatic foci. Relevant retrieval promotes the liver-abscess manifestation above the organism-level syndrome; its chunks are generic sepsis/bacteremia material and do not identify hypervirulent Klebsiella.

DA_d2_heldout200b/660.root_note: Off preserves recurrent ovarian cancer plus BRCA1 mutation. Relevant retrieval yields generic recurrent ovarian cancer and a site-unspecified BRCA-mutated cancer, losing the papillary-serous/ovarian/molecular conjunction despite an ovarian-tumor chunk.

DA_d2_seq100/114.root_note: Synthetic-cannabinoid cerebral vasculopathy is related to but does not explicitly identify reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome. The proxy overaccepted it as complete. Neither off nor relevant exposes a complete reference, so the proxy-derived Top-1 loss is removed; a partial-specificity loss remains.

DA_d2_seq100/15.root_note: The histoplasmosis chunk supports the organism but not the defining primary oral localization. Off names oral histoplasmosis; relevant names only histoplasmosis, a real complete-equivalence loss but not a disease-family loss.

DA_d2_seq100/194.root_note: Off retains the exact hyperoleon-within-lamellar-hole diagnosis at rank two. Relevant retrieval replaces it with generic silicone-oil maculopathy and an unrelated treatment-complication label; the top query-similar ophthalmology passages never describe the defining finding.

DA_d2_seq100/67.root_note: Severe sepsis or septic shock omits the reference-defining anuric kidney failure. The proxy treated it as complete and manufactured an off Top-2 hit; root review retains only partial disease-family credit, so this is not a complete-equivalence retrieval loss.

MCR_seq200b/277.root_note: Off retains nephroblastoma/Wilms tumor at rank two. Relevant renal-cancer chunks reinforce the common adult RCC interpretation and delete the rare adult Wilms candidate despite pediatric-cancer and invasion evidence.

MCR_seq200b/430.root_note: Off retains atrial tachycardia through an epicardial pathway at rank two. Relevant retrieval replaces it with atrial fibrillation, even though the presented rhythm is a mapped tachycardia; generic arrhythmia passages supply no vein-of-Marshall mechanism.

MCR_seq200b/442.root_note: Off correctly ranks topical corticosteroid withdrawal first. Relevant retrieval promotes perioral dermatitis; generic topical-therapy and dermatitis passages do not encode the abrupt three-day withdrawal after two years of daily potent steroid use.

MCR_v1_seq100/11.root_note: Off ranks multisystem inflammatory syndrome first. Relevant retrieval promotes antiphospholipid syndrome, likely amplifying the positive beta2-glycoprotein result and infarcts while discounting shock, myocarditis, rash and gastrointestinal inflammation; the retrieved passages themselves are mostly off-target.

MCR_v1_seq100/93.root_note: Relevant retrieval uniquely names streptokinase-induced serum sickness, correctly integrating the two-week exposure interval, fever and arthralgia. Its hypersensitivity passage offers directionally useful support, although most of the six chunks remain generic.

DA_d2_heldout200b/646.root_note: Radiation proctitis is broader than the solitary radiation-induced ulcer; rectal ulcer due to the SpaceOAR spacer is a clinically complete causal restatement.

DA_d2_heldout200b/758.root_note: COVID-related myocardial injury captures the disease family but omits the defining diffuse necrosis; myocarditis is not established by the contraction-band-necrosis pathology.

DA_d2_seq100/187.root_note: The generic non-Langerhans histiocytosis surfaces are broader than xanthoma disseminatum; Erdheim-Chester disease is distinct. No arm names the reference entity.

MCR_seq200b/296.root_note: Acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis is Sweet syndrome; generic neutrophilic dermatosis is under-specified.

MCR_seq200b/313.root_note: Secondary syphilis is the correct case-specific stage of the generic reference. The compound HIV-and-syphilis label is clinically related but unnecessarily broad.

MCR_seq200b/347.root_note: All arms remain anchored on pituitary adenoma/apoplexy and miss the sellar cavernous hemangioma reference.

MCR_v1_seq100/97.root_note: Fibroadenoma is the correct family but omits the giant juvenile subtype that is central in this premenarcheal 20-cm lesion; phyllodes tumor is a competing entity.
